changelog:
- Initial release of the emails skill for designing and optimizing multi-email sequences (welcome, nurture, onboarding, re-engagement, etc.)
- Provides step-by-step frameworks for common sequence types, timing, subject lines, and copy guidelines
- Includes core principles: one email/one job, value before ask, relevance, and clear path forward
- Covers audience/context assessment, goals, and metrics planning
- Integrates output templates for sequence overviews and individual email drafts
- References supporting tools and integration guides for implementation
summary: When the user wants to create or optimize an email sequence, drip campaign, automated email flow, or lifecycle email program. Also use when the user mentions "email sequence," "drip campaign," "nurture sequence," "onboarding emails," "welcome sequence," "re-engagement emails," "email automation," "lifecycle emails," "trigger-based emails," "email funnel," "email workflow," "what emails should I send," "welcome series," or "email cadence." Use this for any multi-email automated flow. For cold outreach emails, see cold-email. For in-app onboarding, see onboarding.
